headline: Appointment of Belgica Linette Perez as Director of Planning and Development, plus new ordinance for Assistant Director of Personnel.
summary: The committee will review the appointment of Belgica Linette Perez as Director of the Office of Planning and Development and a proposed ordinance creating an Assistant Director of Personnel position. It will also take up several tabled appointments and ordinance proposals.
items: Appointment of Belgica Linette Perez as Director of the Office of Planning and Development (411/26)
Creation of Ordinance for Assistant Director of Personnel, Ord No. 02.48.050 (415/26)
Appointment of Miguel B. Aguilo to the Zoning Board of Appeals (252/26)
Creation of Executive Assistant Position in the Police Department (49/26)
Confirmation of Kervin Valdez to the Airport Commission (041/26)
Confirmation of Sheila Cabrera to the Zoning Board of Appeals (462/24)
Proposed new ordinance for Manager of Financial and Administrative Services, 02.64.060 (323/24)
location: City Council Chambers, 200 Common Street, Lawrence, MA
